name: pixel-crew
description: Pixel-art progress bar with the Claude mascot and a side panel that turns your subagents into a crew of characters. Leigh's fork: improvement-council stages and personas get their own characters.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the band and the Agents panel. auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then your system language (English, Portuguese or Spanish; anything else falls back to English).

celebration.title: Done celebration
celebration.description: What the mascot does when a turn finishes well: full (jumps among confetti), quiet (a short hop, no confetti) or off.
